student_snapshot.llm_observations: Sheila's Xeno dataset had 10 training cases with 50% sick, split cleanly by hair color (5 blue = 0% sick, 5 pink = 100% sick). On the 20-case confusion matrix she recorded TP=9, TN=11, FP=0, FN=0, N=20, achieving the FP=FN=0 invariant. Her metric calculations all yielded 1 (perfect accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, precision) and MCR=0, and she correctly identified hair color as a good predictor with 100% expected accuracy for new cases.
